title: Projective-bundle morphisms are finite type and admit a relatively ample invertible module
statement: Let $h:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] that is projective in the projective-bundle sense [def-trf-projective-bundle-morphism]. Then $h$ is of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and there exists an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module $L$ [def-sc-invertible-module] that is $h$-relatively ample. Here an invertible module $L$ on the source of a morphism $h$ is $h$-relatively ample if $h$ is quasi-compact [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and, for every affine open $V$ of its target, $L|_{h^{-1}(V)}$ is ample in the absolute sense [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module].

source.place: Tag 07RL (lemma-projective-quasi-projective), with Definition Tag 01VW(1) (definition-quasi-projective) and Definition Tag 01VH (definition-relatively-ample).

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-projective-bundle-proper] to $h$ with exactly the assumed finite-type quasi-coherent projective-bundle convention. Thus $h$ is proper. Unfold [def-weil-proper-morphism]: properness includes finite type. Unfold [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]: finite type includes quasi-compactness. This proves the finite-type clause and supplies the quasi-compactness needed below.

source.place: Tag 07RL (lemma-projective-quasi-projective), proof: properness from Tag 01WC (lemma-locally-projective-proper); Tag 01W1 (definition-proper).

proof.text: Unpack def-trf-projective-bundle-morphism to obtain E, its quasi-coherence and finite type, and a closed immersion i into the canonical relative Proj of Sym(E), with i followed by the projection equal to h. Obtain its normalized tautological quotient D from lem-trf-projective-bundle-quotient-geometry. Put L=i^*D.line and q=pulledQuotient D h i hih. The first clause of lem-trf-line-quotient-chart-inverse-pullback supplies invertibility of L and surjectivity of q, for this actual pulled-back quotient.

source.place: Tag 07RL (lemma-projective-quasi-projective), proof: L=i^*O(1); Constructions Tag 01OB (definition-projective-bundle) and the normalized quotient discussion in Section 01OA.

proof.text: Apply lem-trf-line-quotient-homogeneous-fraction-map to q:h^*E ->> L. It supplies a relative graded line map psi for the canonical symmetric algebra, its extension of q, generation everywhere, and a morphism F with the quotient fraction charts and psi.IsCanonicalMap F. The first clause of lem-trf-line-quotient-chart-inverse-pullback applied to i shows F=i from those extension and fraction-chart properties. Substitute this equality. Since a closed immersion is an immersion (def-weil-closed-immersion), lem-trf-graded-immersion-ample-criterion applies to h,L,Sym(E),psi and i, using quasi-compactness from step 1. It gives exactly ampleness of L restricted over every affine target open. Pair this conclusion and invertibility of L with finite type from step 1.

source.place: Tag 07RL (lemma-projective-quasi-projective), proof, expanded through Tag 01VN (lemma-ample-very-ample), whose proof uses Tag 01VJ (lemma-characterize-relatively-ample), implication (6) implies (1). The identification of the map with i is supplied by Constructions Section 01OA, as stated in the cited quotient-geometry node.
